verdict_reason: ASR-classifier path returned outcome=DEFERRED with intent=school_deadline_reminder for the spoken email request; planner did not produce an actionable email_draft plan. Falling back to literal-instruction /api/act path produced a real Gmail draft via direct_gmail_compose, which structurally BYPASSES the SMS pre-confirm gate. The whole-chain test as designed (ASR -> classifier -> planner -> SMS gate -> YES -> action -> draft -> receipt) could not be executed end-to-end. Two components broke: (1) planner mis-classification of a clear email instruction, (2) the SMS gate is unreachable for Gmail drafts by design (per sms_pre_confirm.py docstring line 380).

engine.crash_trigger: POST /api/act with instruction containing verb 'send' (Empty reply from server, engine auto-restarted within 30s, no obvious stack in product-engine.log)

step5_act_empty_body.why_no_sms_gate: The pending plan from /api/listen/upload was mode=clarify. /api/act routes clarify-mode plans to a clarify response (NOT to /run_action_engine where the SMS gate sits). The gate only fires for mode=act plans with intents in {email_draft, gmail_draft, email, send_email, send_message, send_text_message, send_slack_message} that also bypass the parse_draft_intent short-circuit.

step5b_act_with_literal_instruction.why_no_sms_gate: The direct_gmail_compose path short-circuits BEFORE the SMS pre-confirm gate per server.py:7980 and sms_pre_confirm.py:380 (`The three internal short-circuits (_try_direct_browser_action, _try_direct_gmail_draft, _try_structured_gmail_draft) bypass the gate because they are structurally draft-only`). The Gmail draft path is reversible by design, so no gate. The SMS gate is reserved for the DSv4SkillRunner click-Send path and non-Gmail send/post/publish/pay verbs.

Even with literal email instruction (no ASR noise) the planner returns the same classification.
diagnostic_findings.impact: Spoken email requests via /api/listen/upload never reach the act path. The pendant cannot trigger Gmail drafts from speech today.

diagnostic_findings.what: The test plan assumed Gmail draft requests would fire the SMS pre-confirm gate. They don't: the direct_gmail_compose, structured_gmail_draft, and direct_browser_action short-circuits all run BEFORE the gate. The gate is reserved for DSv4SkillRunner click-Send and non-Gmail send/post/pay verbs.
diagnostic_findings.impact: The 'WHOLE chain proves SMS gate -> YES -> dispatch' assertion cannot be exercised against a Gmail draft. To verify the gate end-to-end, the instruction must hit a non-draft surface (Twitter post, Slack send, payment), and TWILIO_MOCK must remain 1 to avoid real SMS.

diagnostic_findings.impact: User says 'send X to Y' and the entire engine dies. The bind+ASR pipeline rejects spoken email requests AND the literal text path crashes for send verbs.
